entities.name: Nicolas Filleul de La Chesnaye
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolas Filleul de La Chesnaye was a French poet. He was professor at the College of Harcourt, Eure where in 1563, he produced Achille (1563). His texts were used for the Ballet Comique de la Reine in 1581.
